My grandfather was one of the soldiers, who helped in the Chernobyl disaster. 
He said they always drank vodka, because vodka helped to reduce radiation contamination in the body. 
But still, he died of liver cancer in the age of 58, that was caused by radiation.

I'm very proud of him and I'm sure he would be glad to see these series and was very happy to see the final titles "In the memory of all who suffered and sacrificed" if he was alive. I started crying when I saw those titles.
Me and my family want to thank all the people who made this film.
